findings.finding: Ishmael is not clearly shown reaching to rouse Queequeg; the gesture reads as recoiling rather than an attempt to wake him.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael’s near hand is lifted toward his own neck in a flinch, with no hand extended toward Queequeg’s shoulder or arm.
findings.repair_prompt: Repose Ishmael so one hand lightly extends toward Queequeg’s shoulder (fingers mid-reach) while the other hand flinches at his neck; keep the patchwork quilt mid-throw, tomahawk-pipe small beside Queequeg, and preserve clean negative space in the bottom-left for caption.

findings.finding: Queequeg’s vigorous self-shake is not depicted.
findings.visible_evidence: Queequeg is upright with one hand on the bedding and the other resting; no motion cues or posture indicating a shake.
findings.repair_prompt: Show Queequeg mid-shake with subtle motion blur or repeated limb positions, shoulders and hair in motion, while he withdraws his arm; keep two-shot at bed edge, Ishmael mid-expostulation, tattoos visible, and the patchwork counterpane.

findings.finding: Top-center caption area is partially encroached by the characters’ heads and textured wall, reducing clean negative space.
findings.visible_evidence: The top-center above the headboard includes Ishmael’s and Queequeg’s head silhouettes and wall texture close to the upper margin.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose to leave an unobstructed, plain band of wall at the top-center (e.g., lower the figures or crop slightly lower); avoid heads or curtains entering that zone.

findings.finding: Shot is not from Ishmael’s POV as specified; the camera shows Ishmael in bed rather than viewing from his eyes.
findings.visible_evidence: Ishmael is clearly visible at left, facing Queequeg, indicating a third-person vantage rather than POV.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose to a medium over-the-blanket POV from Ishmael’s position on the bed (over-shoulder or bed-level), with Queequeg mid-frame gesturing first to the clothes pile and then toward the open door. Preserve clean negative space in the bottom-right for the caption.

findings.finding: The whaling harpoon reads visually as a generic spear; the detachable stock and distinctive straight-edged steel head are not clearly depicted.
findings.visible_evidence: A long pole with a simple triangular point leans against the wall near the chair; no clear detachable stock or lashing details are visible.
findings.repair_prompt: Refine the harpoon so it is unmistakably a 19th-century whaling harpoon: show a detachable wooden stock and a long, straight-edged steel head with proper lashing hardware. Keep its position near the wash-stand/chair; retain all other scene elements and the uncurtained window view.

findings.finding: Top-left caption zone is partially busy with Ishmael, bedpost, and patchwork quilt encroaching, leaving limited clean negative space.
findings.visible_evidence: In the upper-left area, Ishmael’s head and the bed’s post and quilt occupy space up to near the corner of the frame.
findings.repair_prompt: Recompose to reserve a clear top-left caption area: shift the camera slightly right or down, or move Ishmael/bed leftward, adding blank wall in the top-left so text can sit cleanly.
